notes.title: 2022 October Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
2022 October Update :
*   costume appearance change when change armor or cloth.
*   when player has low energy , player walk slower.
*   every few days, spawn a few enemy try to kill player.
*   start from 21 days, the world enter winter, player need to come close to fire source otherwise will freeze to death.
*   overhaul cooking pot UI.
